leadText:
A Tower Tycoon (Japanese: Tower Tycoon) is a Pokémon Trainer who presides over their region's Battle Tower. The Tower Tycoon will battle the of the Tower at set intervals. Anabel and Palmer are the only known Tower Tycoons.

In the English version of , the class is called Salon Maiden, used by Anabel.

===Pokemon the Series===
==== ====
Anabel appeared in Talking a Good Game! and Second Time's the Charm!, where she battled twice for his penultimate challenge. Ash lost their first battle, but he managed to defeat her in a rematch.

==== ====
Palmer debuted in a cameo at the beginning of Arceus and the Jewel of Life, where he battled . He made his debut in Historical Mystery Tour!, where he met up with his son . In Challenging a Towering Figure!, he battled Ash at the Twinleaf Festival and won.

===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
Anabel, along with the rest of the Generation III Frontier Brains, appeared in this arc, assisting in fighting against the villainous Guile Hideout. She is considered to be the strongest of the Hoenn Frontier Brains, being in possession of .

==== ====
Palmer made a brief appearance while encountering Cynthia, revealing that he was in possession of Regigigas at the time, though he was planning on it.

==== ====
Palmer appeared in this arc, assisting in fighting against Team Galactic in the Distortion World with his partner Pokémon, . By the end of the arc, he remained the only Sinnoh Frontier Brain yet to be challenged by . He is the father of , one of Sinnoh's Pokédex holders.

==== ====
Anabel reappeared alongside the other Hoenn Frontier Brains to help in stopping the Admins of Neo Team Aqua and Neo Team Magma.

===Pokémon Battle Frontier===
Anabel appeared in the Pokémon Battle Frontier . She first appeared dressed up as a photographer, but was later revealed to be the Frontier Brain of the . She was the last Frontier Brain challenged by ; their battle ended in a draw, leaving Enta without his final Frontier Symbol.

===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!===
Palmer appeared in Look for Giratina! as Hareta and his friends arrived at the Battle Zone. Pretending to be a member of Team Galactic, he challenged Hareta to a battle, but once the battle had ended in a draw, he revealed his true identity and was revealed to be 's father and friends with Hareta's father, Kaisei.
 

==Trivia==
Though the word " " is actually derived from the Japanese word taikun (a title for the ), it is converted into as an English term to match the names of the other Frontier Brains' Trainer classes, rather than using the or its respective katakana (without the lengthening ).
